observations: Bars 1-16 fell from the bar-1 high 2140.5 to the bar-16 low 1368.42; bar 16 closed 1568.55 with a long lower tail and bar 17 reversed up to close 1687.83.

structures.description: Bear sell-off / selling climax: bars 1-16 declined from the bar-1 high 2140.5 to the bar-16 low 1368.42; bar 16 closed 1568.55 with a long lower tail and bar 17 reversed up to close 1687.83.
Multi-month trading range: bars 17-89 oscillated between the bar-36 low 1512.91 and the bar-67 high 1974.46 with heavy overlap, repeated boundary tests and no sustained directional leg.
Bull breakout spike: bar 90 (open 1916.51, high 2293.8, close 2252.16) broke above the 1512.91-1974.46 base, and bars 91-92 extended to the spike high 2771 on bar 92 (close 2515.3, large upper tail).

Post-spike trading range / possible bull flag: bars 93-119 held between the bar-104 low 2357.18 and the bar-113 high 2680, with overlapping bodies and upper tails at 2557.46 (bar 98), 2537.57 (bar 106) and 2680 (bar 113).
Current bull leg: bar 117 reached 2358.62 and closed 2397.1, then bars 118-120 advanced, with bar 120 (open 2446.22, high 2643.52) closing 2612.02 near its high at the top of the post-spike range.

evidence_for: Base-and-breakout sequence: the 1512.91-1974.46 range resolved upward on the bar-90 bull trend bar, and price has held above it for 28 bars without returning into the base.
Post-spike swing lows are flat to higher (2394.91 bar 101, 2357.18 bar 104, 2411.04 bar 112, 2358.62 bar 117), the shape of a bull flag rather than a top.
Bar 120 is a strong bull bar closing near its high (2612.02 vs high 2643.52), putting the 2680 range top back within reach.
Net window drift is up: bar 1 closed 2065.96 and bar 120 closed 2612.02, with the low 1368.42 well behind the market.
evidence_against: The post-spike range is wide (2357.18-2680, about 13%) and 28 bars long with heavy overlap, so the immediate structure is two-sided rather than a sustained trend.
The bar-92 spike high 2771 has never been retested and the 2680-2771 zone has produced repeated upper tails, so the market may be topping rather than flagging.
The bar 90-92 advance was a very large spike that can be climactic; bars 93-119 never held above 2530, which does not look like trend continuation.
Three separate probes of the range top (bars 98, 106, 113) failed, so the current test on bar 120 could also fail.
transition_conditions: A daily close above 2680 (bar-113 high) confirms a bull breakout of the post-spike range; a subsequent close above 2771 (bar-92 spike high) resumes the daily bull trend.
A daily close below 2357.18 (bar-104 low) breaks the range floor and shifts the read toward a bear leg or a larger trading range.
A daily close back below 1974.46 (bar-67 base high) would negate the bar-90 breakout and undermine the bull-trend classification.
Continued overlapping closes between 2357.18 and 2680 keep the phase as range and keep Always-In relevance low.

observations: 120 closed D1 bars, open_time 1779494400000 to 1789776000000, with the decision at the close of the final bar (close_time 1789862399999).
Window high is 2771 (bar 90, open_time 1787270400000); window low is 1368.42 (bar 14, open_time 1780704000000).
Bars 10-14 (1780358400000-1780704000000) are five overlapping bear bars driving 2006.17 down to 1368.42; bar 14 closes 1568.55, about 200 points above its low, a sell-climax tail.

Bar 88 (1787097600000) opens 1916.51 inside the prior consolidation and closes 2252.16 near its 2293.8 high; bars 89-90 close 2326.32 and 2515.3, and bar 90 prints 2771 and closes 255.7 below that high.
Bars 91-119 overlap between 2357.18 (bar 102 low, 1788307200000) and 2700 (bar 119 high); bar 90's low of 2325.31 was never revisited.
Roughly equal lows at 2357.18 (bar 102) and 2358.62 (bar 115, 1789430400000) form a double bottom at the range low, followed by four higher closes (2416.57, 2446.22, 2612.02, 2632.98).

structures.description: Bear leg into a sell climax: bars 0-14 decline from bar 0's 2143.61 high to bar 14's 1368.42 low; the final bars are large bear trend bars and bar 14 closes 200.13 above its low.

Two-sided consolidation (bars 61-87, about 27 bars): upper boundary is bar 65's 1974.46 high with repeated 1919-1938 highs; lower boundary is the triple equal low 1821.69/1821.59/1821.49 (bars 70-72). Bar 88 later opened at 1916.51 inside it before breaking out.
Three-bar bull spike (bars 88-90): 1916.51 to 2252.16 to 2326.32 to a 2515.3 close, with bar 90 reaching 2771 and closing 255.7 off the high - a buy-climax bar.
Post-climax trading range (bars 91-119): upper boundary 2771.00 with internal highs capped at 2557.46, 2537.57, 2680 and 2700; lower boundary 2357.18 (bar 102 low), retested at 2358.62 (bar 115).
Recent bull leg: four consecutive bull closes from bar 115's 2358.62 low to bar 119's 2700 high; bar 119's close 2632.98 is the highest close of the window.

evidence_for: Net window change is upward (open 2066.43 to close 2632.98) and the post-crash lows rose: 1368.42 (bar 14), 1512.91 (bar 34), 1803.74 (bar 55), 1821.49 (bar 72), 2357.18 (bar 102).

Bar 88 broke out of a roughly 27-bar consolidation with a 377.29-point range (1905.63-2293.8) closing at 2252.16, and bars 89-90 followed through to 2771, satisfying the breakout-plus-follow-through test.
Price holds well above the breakout: the last close 2632.98 is about 38% above bar 88's 1905.63 low and has not returned to bar 89's 2111 low.
The most recent leg is bull: four consecutive higher closes off the 2358.62 double-bottom retest, and bar 119's 2632.98 is the highest close in the supplied window.
The post-spike range has held above the spike bar's 2325.31 low and keeps making higher swing lows inside the range (2357.18 then 2358.62 with a higher close).
evidence_against: Bar 90's 2771 high with a close 255.7 lower is a buy-climax bar, and the 29 bars since then overlap inside the range rather than trending - trading-range behavior after a climax.
No close has exceeded 2771; the recent highs 2680 (bar 111) and 2700 (bar 119) are below the spike high, so the range top has already rejected the bulls.
Bar 115 fell from 2517.53 to 2358.62 in a single bar, showing fast two-sided movement inside the range and poor trend persistence.
The final bar closed 67.02 below its own 2700 high, so there is no acceptance yet at the upper boundary; the bull push is an in-range leg, not a confirmed breakout.
The 2357.18 and 2358.62 lows are roughly equal, which marks a range floor that has been tested twice and can break rather than hold.
transition_conditions: A close above 2771 followed by a bar holding above 2771 would confirm a bull breakout and move the read toward breakout-spike/channel.
Rejection at 2700-2771 with a bear close back below 2604.75 keeps the range classification and supports rotation back toward the 2400 area.
A close below 2357.18 would break the range's double bottom and shift the read toward a range breakdown or deeper bear leg.
A close below 2111 (bar 89 low) or 1905.63 (bar 88 low) would negate the bull breakout structure and make the bear side the structural read.
Continued overlapping bars closing between roughly 2400 and 2700 would keep phase as range and Always-In relevance low.

observations: Window opens at 2116.86 and falls to 1368.42 (bar 13 low, close 1568.55), then reverses; final close 2642.90 is about +24.9% versus the first open and about +93% above the window low.
Bars 87-89 are the spike: 1916.51 to 2252.16, 2252.20 to 2326.32, 2326.31 to 2515.30, with the window high 2771 printed on bar 89.
Bars 90-116 are two-sided: overlapping bodies, highs at 2557.46 (bar 95) and 2609.02 (bar 113), lows clustered 2357.18-2425.44; bar 110 spiked to 2680 and closed 2514.72 back inside the range.

Bars 117-119 close 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90 — the first consecutive closes above the 2557.46 ceiling; bar 117 has open 2446.22, high 2643.52, low 2436.87, range 206.65, closing in its top quarter; bar 118 reaches 2700.

Bar 119 (open 2632.98, high 2645.88, low 2568.16, close 2642.90) is a 77.72-range bar closing near its high while holding above the range ceiling; it makes a lower high than bar 118 (2645.88 vs 2700).
Price 2642.90 remains below the bar-89 spike high 2771, so the post-spike section is not yet a confirmed new-high trend.

structures.description: Opening bear leg: a run of lower highs and lower lows from 2116.86 (first open) to 1368.42 (bar 13 low), with widening ranges into bars 9-13 (2006.06->1859.02, 1859.01->1813.04, 1813.04->1731.00, 1731.00->1581.32, 1581.32->1568.55).

Selling climax / possible mtr-like low area: bar 13 prints the window low 1368.42 with its close 1568.55 well above that low, and bar 14 reverses to close 1687.83 near its high (high 1690.78) after opening 1568.55.

Bull sequence from the window low: rising swing lows 1512.91/1533.12, 1821.49, 2357.18, 2358.62 punctuated by consolidations (about 1512-1725, 1850-1975, 2357-2557); successive bull legs reached 1954.36 (bar 59) and 2771 (bar 89).

Two-sided trading range after the bar-87..89 spike: overlapping bars between the 2357.18 low (bar 101) and the 2557.46 high (bar 95), with two upside probes that closed back inside — 2680 high closing 2514.72 (bar 110) and 2609.02 high closing 2514.07 (bar 113).

Upside breakout attempt from that range: bars 117-119 close 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90, the first closes above the 2557.46 ceiling, with bar 118 printing 2700, the highest high since the 2771 spike of bar 89.

evidence_for: Successive higher lows and higher highs since the range low: 2357.18 -> 2358.62 -> 2413.82 -> 2436.87 and 2557.46 -> 2680 -> 2700.

Three consecutive closes above the range ceiling 2557.46 (2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90) after bars 110 and 113 exceeded it intraday but closed back inside at 2514.72 and 2514.07 — the first sustained push beyond the ceiling.
Bar 117 is a large bull trend bar (2446.22 to 2612.02, range 206.65) closing in its top quarter, and bar 118 adds follow-through to 2700; bar 119 holds above the ceiling with a close of 2642.90.
Window-scale structure is upward: 14 bear bars to 1368.42, then a bull reversal and roughly 105 bars of rising swing lows off 1368.42.
evidence_against: The breakout is only three bars; the preceding 27 bars overlap heavily and the region 2357-2557 can still be read as the operating trading range rather than broken.
Two earlier upside probes failed to hold: bar 110 high 2680 closed 2514.72, bar 113 high 2609.02 closed 2514.07, so upside spikes in this region have recently been rejected.
2642.90 remains below the bar-89 spike high 2771, so the whole post-spike section can be read as one broad trading range whose upper extreme has not been exceeded.

Bar 119 makes a lower high than bar 118 (2645.88 vs 2700) with a lower tail to 2568.16, a pause rather than a strong continuation bar, and bar 114 had just traded down to 2358.62 four bars before the breakout.
transition_conditions: Continuation: additional closes above 2700 with rising closes would indicate acceptance above the range, shifting focus to the 2771 bar-89 spike high.
Failure: closes back below 2568.16 (bar 119 low) and then 2557.46 would indicate a failed breakout and a return into the 2357.18-2557.46 range.
A close below 2357.18 would remove the two-sided floor and support a broader range-breakdown or bear-leg read.
Repeated closes between 2557.46 and 2700 without progress would mark a new, higher trading range rather than a continuation trend.

observations: The window opens at 2109.85 (close of 1779667200000) after a 2139.34 high, then declines 13 bars to 1368.42 (low of 1780704000000), about 36% below 2139.34.

Bar 1780704000000 has a 230.85 range with a 200.13 lower tail and closes at 1568.55 (top ~13% of its range); bar 1780790400000 (open 1568.55, high 1690.78, low 1563.52, close 1687.83) is a bull reversal bar closing at its high.

From 1780790400000 to 1787011200000 (73 bars) price overlaps repeatedly between 1512.91 (low of 1782432000000) and 1974.46 (high of 1785110400000); closes cluster 1550-1950 with many overlapping bodies and mixed closes (two-sided range).

Bars 1787184000000 through 1789603200000 (27 bars) stay between 2357.18 (low of 1788307200000) and 2680 (high of 1789084800000); bodies overlap and closes sit mostly 2380-2530.

structures.description: Bear leg of 13 bars from the window high 2139.34 into the 1368.42 low of 1780704000000; bar ranges expand into the low and that bar closes 1568.55 with a 200.13 lower tail, followed by a bull reversal bar at 1687.83.

73-bar two-sided range from 1780790400000 to 1787011200000; repeated overlap between 1512.91 and 1974.46 with a slight upward tilt after the 1512.91 low, many inside bars and closes in the middle of the range.
Bull spike escaping the 73-bar range: bar 1787097600000 opens 1916.51 and closes 2252.16 above the 1974.46 range top, with follow-through to the 2771 spike high of 1787270400000.

Post-spike pause of 27 bars between the 2357.18 low of 1788307200000 and the 2680 high of 1789084800000; most highs sit 2520-2560 with probes to 2680 and most lows 2357-2440, heavy body overlap and mid-range closes.

Final bull leg from the 2358.62 low of bar 1789430400000: 1789689600000 and 1789776000000 close 2612.02 and 2632.98, and 1789948800000 closes 2775.61 above the 2771 spike high. The breakout proper is bars 1789689600000-1789948800000.

evidence_for: A 388.17-point bull trend bar (1787097600000) closed at 2252.16, 89% of its range and above the 73-bar range top 1974.46, with immediate follow-through to 2771 two bars later.
Successive higher swing highs across the window (1974.46, 2293.80, 2771, 2850) and higher swing lows (1368.42, 1512.91, 2357.18/2358.62).
The 27-bar pause held entirely above the breakout bar's open 1916.51 and the old range top 1974.46; no close returned inside the 73-bar range.
The final bar closes 2775.61 above the prior spike high 2771 and in the upper 64% of its range, with four consecutive rising closes.
evidence_against: The strongest counterargument: the largest single directional move in the window is the opening 12-bar, ~36% bear leg to 1368.42, so the bull-trend label rests only on the last ~34 bars, and the 73 bars before that are balance, not trend.

The 27 bars ahead of the final push are a two-sided range (2357.18-2680) with heavy overlap and mid-range closes; 2850 is a first-bar probe only 79.00 above 2771, and single-bar breakouts of multi-week range tops often fail and re-enter the range.

Bar 1787270400000 (445.69 range, close 2515.30, ~255.70 upper tail) followed by a 27-bar stall is spike-high behavior consistent with a temporary exhaustion and a market capped by a range boundary rather than a functioning bull channel.
The 208.30-point final bar after an extended advance could be a buy climax; a large bull bar that is immediately retraced would mark exhaustion rather than breakout acceptance.
transition_conditions: Bull continuation: several consecutive closes holding above 2700 (high of 1789776000000) and above 2771, with higher lows above 2641.70, would confirm acceptance above the spike high and strengthen the bull-trend/breakout-spike read.

Failed breakout: a close back below 2641.70 (low of the final bar), followed by a close below 2568.16 (low of 1789862400000), would signal the breakout failed and shift the read back toward the 2357.18-2680 range.
Range reassertion: a close back below 2357.18 with follow-through would turn the post-spike structure into a top and recast the 1787097600000 advance as a bull trap.
Trend weakening: deeper pullbacks that overlap prior swing lows together with more bear bars closing near their lows would move the phase from breakout-spike toward channel or range.
Climax risk: a further outsized bull bar immediately followed by a bear bar closing near its low would argue for a buy climax rather than a sustained second leg.
